```{r}
data <- read.csv("/Users/alexislagers/Desktop/new_cust_billing_event_log_2026-10-08-1524_clean.csv")

head(data)
```


```{r}
library(tidyr)
library(lubridate)
library(bupaR)
library(data.table)

# 2. Timestamp omzetten en de twee ontbrekende kolommen aanmaken
data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    EL_ACTIVITY_START_TIMESTAMP = as.POSIXct(
      EL_ACTIVITY_START_TIMESTAMP,
      format = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%OS %z",
      tz = "Europe/Brussels"
    ),
    lifecycle = "complete",   # elke rij is één afgerond event
    resource  = "unknown"     # er is geen originator in de log
  ) %>%
  arrange(EL_CASE_ID, EL_ACTIVITY_START_TIMESTAMP)

# 3. Eventlog aanmaken
log <- eventlog(
  eventlog             = data,
  case_id              = "EL_CASE_ID",
  activity_id          = "EL_ACTIVITY_TYPE",
  activity_instance_id = "EL_EVENT_ID",
  timestamp            = "EL_ACTIVITY_START_TIMESTAMP",
  lifecycle_id         = "lifecycle",
  resource_id          = "resource"
)

# 4. Snelle check: verwacht 301.980 events, 25.819 cases, 28 activiteiten
n_cases(log)
n_activities(log)
nrow(log)

```
